name: CORNER STORE
about: Items by the one: Spindles, Strings, Weaves and the shapes. While it is open, your items come into focus over the map.

name: Clock smith.
about: Turns the day's clock to any other time of day (the further away, the dearer), or to this time yesterday or tomorrow. While it is open, the time of day comes into focus over the map.

name: XACT change
about: Buys Magnetic, Neutron and Pulsing (1 for every 10 Bright; Dim, as Ink, is INFINITE LINE's now), in lots of 100, 10,000 and 1,000,000 Bright; and buys them back from you for a little less.

name: GIFT SHOP
about: Going in ends the run: the purse, ducks, discoveries, the journal, the map and your buoy's parts and mounts are all lost (a new buoy keeps its colour, with the record player on its mast). Souvenirs are bought from your last Bright, and they are kept whatever comes next: below deck, in the Hull Compartment. It opens on a bright clear where nothing was collected.

name: BRiGHT IDEAS
tag: Like a spoon that is also a fork.
about: Upgrades that last: the net (Swoop net, Big hoop, Really big hoop; a Metal strainer, a Vast mesh and an Electric fence for the exotics; a Trolling net for the hull), remnant processing, the chest's compartments, how many Spindles, Strings and Weaves you hold, Freeze frame (BALANCE), mount strengths, light limits and game speeds.

name: Dim’s: Carnival of Discovery
about: Sells cards, each once a day: a Card of Secrets turns up an event or Guide entry you have not found and shows you its card (gone once nothing is left); Fortune Telling gives a good fortune or a dim one, for tomorrow; a Daily Wonder keeps one of three bonuses, each with a catch, for a full day (until this time tomorrow).

name: premium NEUTRINOS
about: Density: Knots and Lenses placed on Sectors and the Center, the Neutron pouch, and Pure Density.

name: MAGNETS & STUFF
about: Magnets: magnetic gadgets and hull attachments (an anchor, a rudder, a motor, a horseshoe magnet), the Magnetic pouch, a mini fridge and Pure Harmony.

name: the PULSE
about: Rhythm: Strings, Spindles, Gates and Keys placed on Sectors and the Center, and the Pulsing pouch.

name: INFINITE LINE
about: The nib: how many things shine at once (1, then 5, 15 and 30), and what wiping, double dabbing and mopping cost it; Ink (Dim, by the lot), Deeper Well (DEPTH) and how many Prisms, Knots, Lenses, Keys and Gates you can hold.

name: CUSTOM HULLS
about: Parts for your buoy: floats in every material, masts that carry more, a spotlight that holds two, and things to hang on them. A part you own is fitted again here, free. It opens on a bright clear whose surface gave more Bright than BRiGHT IDEAS' best.

name: DUCK SHOP
about: Trades ducks: Flip a Duck (1), Exotic Duck (5 of one kind), Pick a Duck (99). Also Luck Charms (+5% duck chance today and +1% on your next drop; each ×10 the last, back to 5,000 a day) and the Lucky Duck (for good: base chances ×2, each miss +4%). Every Dark Remnant that is not a duck raises the next one's chance until one comes.
